reviews.title: Garbage App
reviews.text:
I don’t know how hard it is to make an app in today’s world, but I’ve spent more than 30 minutes trying to get this thing to work in various capacities. Everything from being able to login successfully to create an account, to having it connect with my watch and phone has been a pointless waste of time.

And it’s not me, it is 100% a broken garbage app, don’t waste your time with it, let your workplace know that it doesn’t work too so that they stop trying to use it for their stupid walking challenges

reviews.title: Simply terrible
reviews.text: This app is used for an annual fundraiser by IICF and every year we curse that they continue partnering with Terryberry. The app and website are equally terrible. The app logs you off in the middle of working, does not consistently sync with any external app for step count, and is so convoluted for the user. It’s truly a wonder how the overall rating of the app is so high. Maybe if you pay it actually functions.

reviews.title: Useless, terrible app

The sign in process for garmin asked for an email code (mfa). I would leave this app to go to the email app to get the code and when I would return to this app, the sign in process had lost its state and restarted. Absolutely maddening. There is no point to this app except to drive frustration.
